videos.title: Skeleton Screens vs. Progress Bars vs. Spinners
videos.why: Three ways to show that something is loading, and which one to use depending on how long the wait is and what is loading.

videos.title: WWDC19: Designing Audio-Haptic Experiences | Apple
videos.why: Apple's principles for sound and haptic feedback, and how combining the two makes taps, alerts and actions feel more real.

podcasts.episode: Microinteractions: An interview with Dan Saffer
podcasts.why: The author of Microinteractions on signature moments and why the small details of feedback make an app feel cared for.

podcasts.episode: Addy Osmani on designing for great performance
podcasts.why: A short conversation with Chrome engineer Addy Osmani on how design decisions affect how fast an app feels.

reads.title: Using Swipe to Trigger Contextual Actions
reads.why: When swipe actions on list items help, and the problems they cause when they are hidden from view or used inconsistently within one app.

reads.title: Invisible Details of Interaction Design
reads.why: A visual essay on why good gestures feel natural, covering momentum, interruptible motion and reusing metaphors people already know.

reads.title: Designing Empty States in Complex Applications: 3 Guidelines
reads.why: How to use an empty screen to explain what will appear there and how to get started, instead of leaving people stuck.
